integrity.basis: analytic proof of global minimization and local stability, using published first-passage means
integrity.scientific_status: self-review only; independent scientific validation not performed
integrity.verification: reproducible standard-library script with 748 passing checks including independent finite-difference boundary-value evaluation

scientific_limitations: Spatial optimum over \(x\in[0,L]\) only, with a single fixed positive resetting rate.
Reflecting Brownian motion on a compact interval, zero detection radius, symmetric constant diffusivity, Poisson resets to the chosen start position.
The exact all-position mean cover-time formula is prior literature; the claim is the complete exact global and local optimizer classification.
No proof for non-Poisson clocks, independent start/reset positions, distribution-valued reset locations, or arbitrary drift.
A broader previously published optimization theorem may implicitly cover the phase diagram; independent scholarly validation is outstanding.
title: Endpoint-to-midpoint transition in the optimal reset location for interval cover times
